description: Are both owners admitted when they change different rows of the same small data page, and what does the resolution order keep? Owner A = Workspaces(0) with DBEngine.OpenDatabase(A, writable); owner B = DBEngine.CreateWorkspace('second', dbUseJet) with its own OpenDatabase(A, writable); one STA. A: BeginTrans; UPDATE T SET V = 9 WHERE ID = 1. B: BeginTrans; UPDATE T SET V = 101 WHERE ID = 5; DBEngine.Errors. B CommitTrans, then A Rollback; DBEngine.Errors; read T through each owner; close both; read T through a fresh Workspace. Statements use dbFailOnError.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
